meta.method: Weekly EIA Regular x All Formulations retail gasoline price (R1). National = FRED GASREGW (EIA source); states parsed from EIA .xls archives with a pure-Python OLE2/BIFF8 reader.
meta.freshness: EIA weekly cadence — refresh via npm run data:gas
meta.verification_note: Parser verification gate: national .xls R1 column is identical to FRED GASREGW on all 1,484 overlap weeks (max abs diff 0.0). The .xls archives are sparse snapshots (some weeks blank in source); national history uses the complete FRED series.

centroid_note: Approximate state label points [lon, lat] for map pins, not precise locations.
